**Coaching Note:**

Your knight on e5 and queen work together. The forcing sequence Qb3+ gives check, driving the king to h8. Then Nf7+ forks the king and queen—Black must block with the rook, which becomes undefended. Qxf7 wins the rook cleanly. Always look for forcing moves (checks first) that exploit loose pieces and overloaded defenders. Here, the queen on d8 couldn't defend the rook.
